first_step_test: A broad folded half-moon shell with a deliberate top opening fixes the taco width and leaves space for its filling.

source.notes: First sheet rejected for drifting lettuce landmarks and fewer tomato pieces than planned. A revised sheet must hold three lettuce tufts and two tomato pieces fixed.

final_elements.name: outer folded shell
final_elements.description: One wide uneven half-moon shell with a gently rounded bottom and open upper edge.

final_elements.name: inner shell rim
final_elements.description: A shallow curved rim follows the shell opening from left to right.

final_elements.name: left lettuce tuft
final_elements.description: One ruffled lettuce tuft rises behind the left rim.

final_elements.name: center lettuce tuft
final_elements.description: One ruffled lettuce tuft rises behind the center rim.

final_elements.name: right lettuce tuft
final_elements.description: One ruffled lettuce tuft rises behind the right rim.

final_elements.name: left tomato piece
final_elements.description: A small angular tomato piece sits between left and center lettuce.

final_elements.name: right tomato piece
final_elements.description: A small angular tomato piece sits between center and right lettuce.

final_elements.name: left shell crease
final_elements.description: One short curved crease marks the lower left shell.

final_elements.name: right shell crease
final_elements.description: One short curved crease marks the lower right shell.

frames.visible_job: With a black felt tip, draw one wide uneven half-moon for the shell, rounding its bottom and leaving the upper edge open.
frames.instruction: With a black felt tip, draw one wide uneven half-moon for the shell, rounding its bottom and leaving the upper edge open.

frames.visible_job: Inside the open top, draw one shallow curved rim from the left shell tip to the right shell tip.
frames.instruction: Inside the open top, draw one shallow curved rim from the left shell tip to the right shell tip.

frames.visible_job: Behind the rim, add three separate leafy ruffles: left, center and right. Keep each tuft attached to the upper opening.
frames.instruction: Behind the rim, add three separate leafy ruffles: left, center and right. Keep each tuft attached to the upper opening.

frames.visible_job: Between the three lettuce tufts, draw two small angular tomato pieces, one on each side of the center tuft. Let their lower edges hide behind the established rim.
frames.instruction: Between the three lettuce tufts, draw two small angular tomato pieces, one on each side of the center tuft. Let their lower edges hide behind the established rim.

frames.visible_job: Inside the lower shell, draw one short curved crease on the left and one on the right, well below the filling.
frames.instruction: Inside the lower shell, draw one short curved crease on the left and one on the right, well below the filling.

final_step.step_name: Fill the taco with marker color
final_step.visible_job: Fill the established shell golden yellow, lettuce green and two tomato pieces coral red with visible marker strokes.
final_step.instruction: Let the black dry. Fill the existing shell golden yellow, the three lettuce tufts bright green and the two tomato pieces coral red. Leave a few white paper streaks in each area.
adds: marker color within established shell and filling
